title: The Weeping Willow
text: A willow drips sap that smells of sleep, of warm beds and summer afternoons. Its roots have wrapped a dozen sleepers, smiling, and grown into them. The frailest of you is nodding already.

options.label: The frailest is already nodding. They sit a moment and learn its trick, before it learns theirs.

outcomes.text: They wake, and know how to sleep anywhere.

options.label: The strongest cuts the sleepers free, whether they wish it or not.

outcomes.text: Most wake, weeping to be woken. One gives you a ring.

options.label: Burn the willow, and wake every sleeper it holds.

outcomes.text: The sleepers scream as they wake, and some of them do not stop.
